test_count: tests passed, \d+ tests failed out of (\d+)
notes: assert() is COMPILED OUT under NDEBUG, which RelWithDebInfo and Release both define. A C++ suite written with assert() and gated in a release configuration passes unconditionally — every test, always. Use explicit return codes, or gate in Debug.
GENERATE_SOURCES is the cmake CONFIGURE, not a codegen step. `build/` is gitignored, so a
fresh clone has no build tree and `cmake --build build` fails outright — the first CI push
goes red. Configuring in prepare is what makes the gate work from a clean checkout.
--no-tests=error is REQUIRED. ctest's default on an empty selection is 'No tests were
found!!!' and exit 0, so a misspelled label reports a green gate that ran nothing. ctest is
a third case beyond the vitest/pytest/jest defaults the general note lists.
clang-tidy without a .clang-tidy carrying WarningsAsErrors reports findings and exits 0 —
a lint stage that cannot fail. The fixture ships one; so must every scaffolded project.
Bare tool names are correct here and nowhere else: C++ has no package manager, and
ci-cpp.yml apt-installs clang-format, clang-tidy and cmake globally.
BUILD is null because the compile stage IS the release artifact. The integration ctest is
what gives `full` a stage of its own.
